Primitives: `IsSeamLift` (TurningNumber.lean:124-125) is exactly the printed "continuous θ:[0,1]→ℝ, T(s)=(cos θ,sin θ)"; `tw_lift_independent` (tw L = (θ1−θ0)/2π for every seam lift) plus `tw_integer` renders "the integer tw(T) is independent of the lift"; `shift a` (T(s+a)) is the seam change; `Reparam` (continuous, StrictMono, φ(s+1)=φ(s)+1, TurnLift.lean:116-120) is the printed proof's own model (d1_setup.tex 842-845); `reverse` = s↦γ(−s) equals the printed γ(1−s) by 1-periodicity; `DirectionHomotopy`/`RegularHomotopy` with t∈ℝ are equivalent to printed [0,1]-families via projIcc extension/restriction. CV's (i) and (iii) texts are letter-for-letter identical to SM's (sm-3:3547-3552, 3561-3575), so there is no CV-specific wording the SM models fail to cover.

CLAUSE (ii) (excerpt 10-17 vs lines 107-139): the likeliest place for a refutation (SM rotationNumber substituted for CV's ray formula) does not occur. Every (ii) field is stated on CV's `rot L hL : ℤ := rotRay L (Classical.choose …)` = Σ_i ε_i(r) (Rotation.lean:134-139, epsRot :58-62 = the printed three-case ε_i). `polygon_two_pi_rot` is the printed identity; `polygon_path_constant` (Mathlib Path in LabelledTuple c, all points Regular), `polygon_flat_subdivision` (insert q_i+tδ_i, 0<t<1 — I checked t≤0 or t≥1 produces a kink/zero edge, so 0<t<1 is exactly a positive flat subdivision), `polygon_reversal`, `polygon_triangle` (LabelledTuple 3; rot = sign of every turn ∧ rot=±1 = "according to the common sign") are the printed consequences. Hypothesis check: `Regular` (Setup.lean:192-193) is verbatim 𝓡_c; no `3 ≤ c` is needed — for c=1 edge L 0 = L0−L0 = 0, for c=2 edge L 1 = −edge L 0 (l=1 violates the no-doubling-back clause), so Regular forces c≥3 as the header claims; `[NeZero c]` correctly excludes ZMod 0 = ℤ, which is not the printed (ℝ²)^c.
